issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Three Defendants in Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme Sentenced to Total of 155 Months' Imprisonment
supports: Abdihakim Ali Ahmed was sentenced on 2026-08-26 to 54 months for one count of wire fraud and one count of money laundering.
Ahmed Abdullahi Ghedi was sentenced on 2026-08-26 to 65 months for one count of wire fraud and one count of money laundering.
Ahmed Sharif Omar-Hashim, aka Salah Donyale, was sentenced on 2026-08-27 to 36 months for one count of wire fraud.
USAO-MN described Ahmed, Ghedi, and Omar-Hashim as the 24th, 25th, and 26th Feeding Our Future defendants sentenced.
does_not_support: The release does not state restitution or forfeiture amounts for these three defendants.
The release does not resolve the separately reported 2026-08-27 Hussein Mohamed Farah sentencing or the apparent sentence-count sequencing issue.
notes: Use the individual sentence terms, not only the 155-month aggregate. Do not infer restitution amounts from silence in this release.
